const fs=require('fs'),crypto=require('crypto'),assert=require('assert/strict');const root='/workspace/LegionCode-R3-JSONB-REPAIR-20261114',dir='/tmp/r3-jsonb-repair-20261114';const {Client}=require(root+'/node_modules/.pnpm/pg@8.20.0/node_modules/pg');const P=require(dir+'/protocol.cjs');const c=new Client({host:dir+'/socket',port:55473,user:'agent',database:'postgres'});const sha=s=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex');
(async()=>{await c.connect();const original=P.ChatImageAttachmentRefSchema.parse({type:'image_attachment',attachmentId:'in_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',name:'image.png',mediaType:'image/png',byteSize:3});const payload={operation:'turn.steer',text:'text',mediaRefs:[original],targetTurnId:'trn_'+'b'.repeat(24),targetRunAttemptId:'attempt_'+'c'.repeat(24)};const before=JSON.stringify(payload);const stored=(await c.query('SELECT $1::jsonb AS content',[JSON.stringify({mediaRefs:[original]})])).rows[0].content.mediaRefs;const after=JSON.stringify({...payload,mediaRefs:stored});const canonical=JSON.stringify({...payload,mediaRefs:stored.map(x=>P.ChatImageAttachmentRefSchema.parse(x))});assert.notEqual(before,after);assert.notEqual(sha(before),sha(after));assert.equal(before,canonical);const out={postgresVersion:(await c.query('SHOW server_version')).rows[0].server_version,query:'SELECT $1::jsonb AS content',originalKeys:Object.keys(original),storedKeys:Object.keys(stored[0]),originalSerialization:before,storedSerialization:after,canonicalSerialization:canonical,originalFingerprint:sha(before),storedOrderFingerprint:sha(after),reparsedFingerprint:sha(canonical),conclusion:'JSONB key ordering changes fingerprint; existing canonical ref schema projection restores original persistImages order.'};fs.writeFileSync(dir+'/jsonb-proof.json',JSON.stringify(out,null,2)+'\n');console.log('Real PostgreSQL JSONB key-order/fingerprint divergence reproduced; schema projection restoresexacthash');await c.end();})().catch(async e=>{console.error(e.stack);await c.end();process.exitCode=1});
